status_note: Written from general knowledge of the public site. NOT yet checked against the live pages from our server; the first real run decides.

locations.price: price printed on the product card or page (Rs <n>), per pack
locations.pack: pack size in the title (e.g. 5 kg)
locations.rating: star rating and count if printed
locations.stock: 'Out of stock' / 'Sold out' text if printed

quirks: Prices depend on the pincode and store; product pages usually print MRP and offer price.

anti_bot.behaviour: Public pages may show a bot challenge or require a delivery location before prices appear.
anti_bot.our_response: Never bypass a challenge. Report 'price not visible' and carry on with the other sites.
